# hunch eval: examples

`eval` runs rules over labelled `.diff` fixtures and prints precision and recall per rule. Each fixture starts with `# expect: rule-a, rule-b`.

<!-- case: eval-missing -->
### No fixtures

```sh
npx @kelbie/hunch eval fixtures
```

Exit code **2**.

stderr:

```text
hunch: No .diff fixtures found
```

<!-- /case -->
